rosterBasis.policy: The user-provided 2026-08-23 LCS starter snapshot is the identity basis. Current public roster or retirement conflicts are preserved explicitly rather than silently changing the requested player set.

semantics.contract: Only a publicly verifiable current expiration date is promoted to endDate. Stale GCD dates, retirement conflicts, salary, buyout, and contract start dates are excluded from the current contract field.
semantics.career: Public team-history periods with source precision retained.
semantics.honors: Major public team achievements and individual awards; not every minor event, weekly award, or placement.
semantics.prizeMoney: Approximate public cumulative tournament winnings in USD; not salary, bonus, buyout, or market value.
semantics.age: Completed age as of 2026-08-24. Age remains null where no exact public birth date is available.
